properties.displayName: OJK - Manual attestation for Implement Data Discovery , Classification with DLP policies and enforcement
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Data Loss Prevention (DLP) measures are in place, aligned with the organization's risk assessment, monitor and periodic review. (Data-Security-72).

metadata.Description:
Data Discovery and Classification
Encryption and Access Controls
DLP Policies and Enforcement
for more details - refer to Control statement
Data Discovery and Classification
1. Deploy automated data discovery tools across all cloud platforms to identify and categorize sensitive information
- Scanning data repositories for sensitive information
- Classifying data based on sensitivity levels (e.g., public, internal, confidential, highly confidential)
- Applying appropriate tags to classified data
Encryption and Access Controls
1. To protect data at rest and in transit:
- AES-256 encryption was implemented for all sensitive data stored across cloud platforms
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/security/fundamentals/encryption-overview
- A centralized key management system was integrated with each cloud provider's native key management service.
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) was enforced consistently across all cloud platforms, ensuring the principle of least privilege
DLP Policies and Enforcement
1. Deploy a multi-cloud DLP tool and develop standardized DLP policies aligned with its security requirements and regulatory obligations
. These policies were consistently applied and enforced across all cloud platforms and services, including:
- Blocking unauthorized data transfers
- Encrypting sensitive data in transit
- Applying data ojkking to prevent unauthorized access
